bays.restriction: Controlled parking zone — permit holders or paid parking in marked bays
bays.tariff: Paid parking £5.70 per hour (diesel £9.20) — Southwark Council variation notice, charges from 1 April 2026; the inner zone group (C1, C2, D, F, G, GR) costs £8.60/hr (diesel £13.40)
bays.pay: PayByPhone (app or website) or at a PayPoint shop

bays.restriction: Controlled parking zone C1 in the Stepney and Shadwell parent zone. A permit for any C zone is valid all day in every C zone
bays.tariff: Pay-and-display bays in this zone charge £6.80 per hour (£10.20 for diesel vehicles) — Zone A & C Premium rate. Resident permits (12 months) by emissions band: Band 1 (100 g/km or less) £80; Band 2 (101–150 g/km) £150; Band 3 (151–185 g/km) £260; Band 4 (186 g/km or more) £690. Diesel surcharge £90 per year; second permit +£95, third permit +£260. Resident visitor voucher £3.90 per day (Tower Hamlets parking charges 2026/27)
bays.pay: Pay-and-display machine or an approved parking app (Tower Hamlets is part of the National Parking Platform)

bays.times: Open 24 hours; hourly rates Mon-Fri 6am-7pm and Sat 6am-1:30pm, one-off fee outside those hours
bays.tariff: By vehicle type, per hour (Mon-Fri 6am-7pm, Sat 6am-1:30pm): electric / hydrogen / hybrid £4.50 · petrol (registered from 2005) £5.80 · diesel (registered from 2015) £5.80 · any other vehicle £8.10. Outside those hours a one-off fee applies at the same figures (£4.50 / £5.80 / £8.10). Motorcycles and bicycles free in designated bays; disabled badge holders pay normal rates
bays.pay: Card at the car park (Visa, Visa Debit, Mastercard). No bookings or reservations
